title: Pomodoro Timer
description: Boost your productivity using the Pomodoro technique – focus in short bursts and take regular breaks!
how_to_play:
1. Set your desired focus duration (default: 25 minutes).
2. Press Start to begin your focus session.
3. Work on your task without distractions until the timer ends.
4. Take a short break (default: 5 minutes) when the session is complete.
5. Repeat cycles and take a longer break after 4 sessions.

Tips:
- Customize session and break lengths to fit your workflow.
- Keep a task list nearby to track what you’re working on.
- Use sound or visual alerts to stay on track.
